name: custtoolset_pillar13_extractor
description: Extracts the deployment context of the auditing tool, evaluating the environment type (Sandbox/Production) and mapping the multi-account (OneWorld) Hub-and-Spoke topology.

analysisType.description: The deployment topology metric to extract. Use 'environment_context' to retrieve Account ID and Sandbox/Production status, or 'multi_account_topology' to map the global subsidiary hierarchy.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing the runtime environment variables and the organizational subsidiary map.
